items.title: PaperCut Replaces Emergency Patches With Fixes for Two Actively Exploited Flaws
items.summary: PaperCut on Thursday released a new security maintenance release that replaces all previously published emergency patches that were pushed to address two security flaws that have come under active exploitation.
